mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has risen monotonically for three straight weeks (-14.9 to -12.3), indicating a steady return of commuting and daytime activity that spills over into retail and recreation visits, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise by more than 0.5 points per week over the next two weeks despite the observed deceleration.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 3.7 to 0.9 to -0.9 over the last two weeks
